verses.sa:
ये त्रिषप्ताः परियन्ति विश्वा रूपाणि बिभ्रतः ।
वाचस्पतिर्बला तेषां तन्वो अद्य दधातु मे ॥
verses.rom:
ye trishaptah pariyanti vishva rupani bibhratah |
vachaspatirbala tesham tanvo adya dadhatu me ||
verses.en: The thrice seven that go about, bearing all forms—let the lord of speech assign to me today their powers, [their] selves (tanū́).

verses.sa:
पुनरेहि वचस्पते देवेन मनसा सह ।
वसोष्पते नि रमय मय्येवास्तु मयि श्रुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
punarehi vachaspate devena manasa saha |
vasoshpate ni ramaya mayyevastu mayi shrutam ||
verses.en: Come again, lord of speech, together with divine mind; lord of good, make [it] stay (ni-ram); in me, in myself be what is heard.

verses.sa:
इहैवाभि वि तनूभे आर्त्नी इव ज्यया ।
वाचस्पतिर्नि यच्छतु मय्येवास्तु मयि श्रुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ihaivabhi vi tanubhe artni iva jyaya |
vachaspatirni yachchhatu mayyevastu mayi shrutam ||
verses.en: Just here stretch thou on, as it were the two tips of the bow with the bow-string; let the lord of speech make fast (ni-yam); in me, in myself, be what is heard.

verses.sa:
उपहूतो वाचस्पतिरुपास्मान् वाचस्पतिर्ह्वयताम् ।
सं श्रुतेन गमेमहि मा श्रुतेन वि राधिषि ॥
verses.rom:
upahuto vachaspatirupasman vachaspatirhvayatam |
sam shrutena gamemahi ma shrutena vi radhishi ||
verses.en: Called on is the lord of speech; on us let the lord of speech call; may we be united with (sam-gam) what is heard; let me not be parted with what is heard.

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं पर्जन्यं भूरिधायसम् ।
विद्मो ष्वस्य मातरं पृथिवीं भूरिवर्पसम् ॥
verses.rom:
vidma sharasya pitaram parjanyam bhuridhayasam |
vidmo shvasya mataram prithivim bhurivarpasam ||
verses.en: We know the reed's father, Parjanya the much-nourishing; and we know well its mother, the earth of many aspects.

verses.sa:
ज्याके परि णो नमाश्मानं तन्वं कृधि ।
वीडुर्वरीयोऽरातीरप द्वेषांस्या कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
jyake pari no namashmanam tanvam kridhi |
vidurvariyo'ratirapa dveshamsya kridhi ||
verses.en: O bow-string, bend about us; make thyself a stone; being hard, put very far away niggards [and] haters.

verses.sa:
वृक्षं यद्गावः परिषस्वजाना अनुस्फुरं शरमर्चन्त्यृभुम् ।
शरुमस्मद्यावय दिद्युमिन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
vriksham yadgavah parishasvajana anusphuram sharamarchantyribhum |
sharumasmadyavaya didyumindra ||
verses.en: When the kine, embracing the tree, sing the quivering dexterous (ṝ ṛbhú) reed, keep away from us, O Indra, the shaft, the missile.

verses.sa:
यथा द्यां च पृथिवीं चान्तस्तिष्ठति तेजनम् ।
एवा रोगं चास्रावं चान्तस्तिष्ठतु मुञ्ज इत् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha dyam cha prithivim chantastishthati tejanam |
eva rogam chasravam chantastishthatu munja it ||
verses.en: As between both heaven and earth stands the bamboo (? téjana), so let the reed-stalk (múñja) stand between both the disease and the flux (āsrāvá).

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं पर्जन्यं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति ॥
verses.rom:
vidma sharasya pitaram parjanyam shatavrishnyam |
tena te tanve sham karam prithivyam te nishechanam bahishte astu baliti ||
verses.en: We know the reed's father, Parjanya of hundredfold virility; with that will I make weal (çám) for thy body; on the earth [be] thine outpouring, out of thee, with a splash!

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं मित्रं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति ॥
verses.rom:
vidma sharasya pitaram mitram shatavrishnyam |
tena te tanve sham karam prithivyam te nishechanam bahishte astu baliti ||
verses.en: We know the reed's father, Mitra of hundredfold virility; with that will etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं वरुणं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति ॥
verses.rom:
vidma sharasya pitaram varunam shatavrishnyam |
tena te tanve sham karam prithivyam te nishechanam bahishte astu baliti ||
verses.en: We know the reed's father, Varuṇa of etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं चन्द्रं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति ॥
verses.rom:
vidma sharasya pitaram chandram shatavrishnyam |
tena te tanve sham karam prithivyam te nishechanam bahishte astu baliti ||
verses.en: We know the reed's father, the moon of etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विद्मा शरस्य पितरं सूर्यं शतवृष्ण्यम् ।
तेना ते तन्वे शं करं पृथिव्यां ते निषेचनं बहिष्टे अस्तु बालिति ॥
verses.rom:
vidma sharasya pitaram suryam shatavrishnyam |
tena te tanve sham karam prithivyam te nishechanam bahishte astu baliti ||
verses.en: We know the reed's father, the sun of etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यदान्त्रेषु गवीन्योर्यद्वस्तावधि संश्रितम् ।
एवा ते मूत्रं मुच्यतां बहिर्बालिति सर्वकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadantreshu gavinyoryadvastavadhi samshritam |
eva te mutram muchyatam bahirbaliti sarvakam ||
verses.en: What in thine entrails, thy (two) groins (? gavīnī́), what in thy bladder has flowed together—so be thy urine released, out of thee, with a splash! all of it.

verses.sa:
प्र ते भिनद्मि मेहनं वर्त्रं वेशन्त्या इव ।
एवा ते मूत्रं मुच्यतां बहिर्बालिति सर्वकम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra te bhinadmi mehanam vartram veshantya iva |
eva te mutram muchyatam bahirbaliti sarvakam ||
verses.en: I split up thy urinator, like the weir of a tank—so be thy etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विषितं ते वस्तिबिलं समुद्रस्योदधेरिव ।
एवा ते मूत्रं मुच्यतां बहिर्बालिति सर्वकम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishitam te vastibilam samudrasyodadheriva |
eva te mutram muchyatam bahirbaliti sarvakam ||
verses.en: Unfastened [be] thy bladder-orifice, like [that] of a water-holding sea—so be thy etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथेषुका परापतदवसृष्टाधि धन्वनः ।
एवा ते मूत्रं मुच्यतां बहिर्बालिति सर्वकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatheshuka parapatadavasrishtadhi dhanvanah |
eva te mutram muchyatam bahirbaliti sarvakam ||
verses.en: As the arrow flew forth, let loose from the bow—so be thy etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अम्बयो यन्त्यध्वभिर्जामयो अध्वरीयताम् ।
पृञ्चतीर्मधुना पयः ॥
verses.rom:
ambayo yantyadhvabhirjamayo adhvariyatam |
princhatirmadhuna payah ||
verses.en: The mothers go on their ways, sisters of them that make sacrifice, mixing milk with honey.

verses.sa:
अमूर्या उप सूर्ये याभिर्वा सूर्यः सह ।
ता नो हिन्वन्त्वध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
amurya upa surye yabhirva suryah saha |
ta no hinvantvadhvaram ||
verses.en: They who are yonder at the sun, or together with whom is the sun—let them further our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अपो देवीरुप ह्वये यत्र गावः पिबन्ति नः ।
सिन्धुभ्यः कर्त्वं हविः ॥
verses.rom:
apo devirupa hvaye yatra gavah pibanti nah |
sindhubhyah kartvam havih ||
verses.en: The heavenly waters I call on, where our kine drink; to the rivers (síndhu) is to be made oblation.

verses.sa:
अप्स्वन्तरमृतमप्सु भेषजम् ।
अपामुत प्रशस्तिभिरश्वा भवथ वाजिनो गावो भवथ वाजिनीः ॥
verses.rom:
apsvantaramritamapsu bheshajam |
apamuta prashastibhirashva bhavatha vajino gavo bhavatha vajinih ||
verses.en: Within the waters is ambrosia (amṛ́ta), in the waters is remedy; and by the praises (práçasti) of the waters ye become vigorous (vājín) horses, ye become vigorous kine.

verses.sa:
आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन ।
महे रणाय चक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
apo hi shtha mayobhuvasta na urje dadhatana |
mahe ranaya chakshase ||
verses.en: Since ye are kindly waters, do ye set us unto refreshment (ū́rj), unto sight of great joy.

verses.sa:
यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः ।
उशतीरिव मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vah shivatamo rasastasya bhajayateha nah |
ushatiriva matarah ||
verses.en: What is your most propitious savor (rása), of that make us share here, like zealous mothers.

verses.sa:
तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ ।
आपो जनयथा च नः ॥
verses.rom:
tasma aram gamama vo yasya kshayaya jinvatha |
apo janayatha cha nah ||
verses.en: We would satisfy you in order to that to the possession of which ye quicken, O waters, and generate us.

verses.sa:
ईशाना वार्याणां क्षयन्तीश्चर्षणीनाम् ।
अपो याचामि भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
ishana varyanam kshayantishcharshaninam |
apo yachami bheshajam ||
verses.en: Of the waters, having mastery of desirable things, ruling over human beings (carṣaṇí), I ask a remedy.

verses.sa:
शं नो देवीरभिष्टय आपो भवन्तु पीतये ।
शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no devirabhishtaya apo bhavantu pitaye |
sham yorabhi sravantu nah ||
verses.en: Be the divine waters weal for us in order to assistance, to drink; weal [and] health flow they unto us.

verses.sa:
अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा ।
अग्निं च विश्वशंभुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
apsu me somo abravidantarvishvani bheshaja |
agnim cha vishvashambhuvam ||
verses.en: Within the waters, Soma told me, are all remedies, and Agni (fire) wealful for all.

verses.sa:
आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे मम ।
ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
apah prinita bheshajam varutham tanve mama |
jyokcha suryam drishe ||
verses.en: O waters, bestow a remedy, protection (várūtha) for my body, and long to see the sun.

verses.sa:
शं न आपो धन्वन्याः शमु सन्त्वनूप्याः ।
शं नः खनित्रिमा आपः शमु याः कुम्भ आभृताः ।
शिवा नः सन्तु वार्षिकीः ॥
verses.rom:
sham na apo dhanvanyah shamu santvanupyah |
sham nah khanitrima apah shamu yah kumbha abhritah |
shiva nah santu varshikih ||
verses.en: Weal for us the waters of the plains, and weal be those of the marshes, weal for us the waters won by digging, and weal what are brought in a vessel; propitious to us be those of the rain.

verses.sa:
स्तुवानमग्न आ वह यातुधानं किमीदिनम् ।
त्वं हि देव वन्दितो हन्ता दस्योर्बभूविथ ॥
verses.rom:
stuvanamagna a vaha yatudhanam kimidinam |
tvam hi deva vandito hanta dasyorbabhuvitha ||
verses.en: Bring hither, O Agni, the sorcerer (yātudhā́па), the kimīdín, speaking out (stu); for thou, O god, being revered, hast become slayer of the barbarian (dásyu).

verses.sa:
आज्यस्य परमेष्ठिन् जातवेदस्तनूवशिन् ।
अग्ने तौलस्य प्राशान यातुधानान् वि लापय ॥
verses.rom:
ajyasya parameshthin jatavedastanuvashin |
agne taulasya prashana yatudhanan vi lapaya ||
verses.en: O most exalted one (parameṣṭhín), Jātavedas, self-controller, Agni, partake of (prа-аç) the sacrificial butter, of the sesame oil (?); make the sorcerers cry out.

verses.sa:
वि लपन्तु यातुधाना अत्त्रिणो ये किमीदिनः ।
अथेदमग्ने नो हविरिन्द्रश्च प्रति हर्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi lapantu yatudhana attrino ye kimidinah |
athedamagne no havirindrashcha prati haryatam ||
verses.en: Let the sorcerers cry out (ví-lap), let the devouring kimīdíns; then do you, O Agni together with Indra, welcome this our oblation.

verses.sa:
अग्निः पूर्व आ रभतां प्रेन्द्रो नुदतु बाहुमान् ।
ब्रवीतु सर्वो यातुमान् अयमस्मीत्येत्य ॥
verses.rom:
agnih purva a rabhatam prendro nudatu bahuman |
bravitu sarvo yatuman ayamasmityetya ||
verses.en: Let Agni first take hold; let Indra, having arms, push forth; let everyone that has a demon, coming, say "here am I."

verses.sa:
पश्याम ते वीर्यं जातवेदः प्र णो ब्रूहि यातुधानान् नृचक्षः ।
त्वया सर्वे परितप्ताः पुरस्तात्त आ यन्तु प्रब्रुवाणा उपेदम् ॥
verses.rom:
pashyama te viryam jatavedah pra no bruhi yatudhanan nrichakshah |
tvaya sarve paritaptah purastatta a yantu prabruvana upedam ||
verses.en: We would fain see thy heroism (vīryà), O Jātavedas; proclaim to

verses.sa:
आ रभस्व जातवेदोऽस्माकार्थाय जज्ञिषे ।
दूतो नो अग्ने भूत्वा यातुधानान् वि लापय ॥
verses.rom:
a rabhasva jatavedo'smakarthaya jajnishe |
duto no agne bhutva yatudhanan vi lapaya ||
verses.en: Take hold, O Jātavedas; thou wast born for our purpose; becoming our messenger, O Agni, make the sorcerers cry out.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने यातुधानान् उपबद्धामिहा वह ।
अथैषामिन्द्रो वज्रेणापि शीर्षाणि वृश्चतु ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne yatudhanan upabaddhamiha vaha |
athaishamindro vajrenapi shirshani vrishchatu ||
verses.en: Do thou, O Agni, bring hither the sorcerers bound; then let Indra with his thunderbolt crush in (api-vraçc) their heads.

verses.sa:
इदं हविर्यातुधानान् नदी फेनमिवा वहत्।
य इदं स्त्री पुमान् अकरिह स स्तुवतां जनः ॥
verses.rom:
idam haviryatudhanan nadi phenamiva vahat|
ya idam stri puman akariha sa stuvatam janah ||
verses.en: This oblation shall bring the sorcerers, as a stream does the foam; whoever, woman [or] man, hath done this, here let that person speak out.

verses.sa:
अयं स्तुवान आगमदिमं स्म प्रति हर्यत ।
बृहस्पते वशे लब्ध्वाग्नीषोमा वि विध्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam stuvana agamadimam sma prati haryata |
brihaspate vashe labdhvagnishoma vi vidhyatam ||
verses.en: This man hath come, speaking out; this man do ye welcome; O Brihaspati, taking [him] into thy control—O Agni and Soma, do ye (two) pierce [him] through.

verses.sa:
यातुधानस्य सोमप जहि प्रजां नयस्व च ।
नि स्तुवानस्य पातय परमक्ष्युतावरम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatudhanasya somapa jahi prajam nayasva cha |
ni stuvanasya pataya paramakshyutavaram ||
verses.en: Of the sorcerer, O soma-drinker, slay the progeny and conduct [him hither]; of him, speaking out, make fall out (nis-pat) the upper eye and the lower.

verses.sa:
यत्रैषामग्ने जनिमानि वेत्थ गुहा सतामत्त्रिणां जातवेदः ।
तांस्त्वं ब्रह्मणा वावृधानो जह्येषां शततर्हमग्ने ॥
verses.rom:
yatraishamagne janimani vettha guha satamattrinam jatavedah |
tamstvam brahmana vavridhano jahyesham shatatarhamagne ||
verses.en: Wherever, O Agni, thou knowest the births of them, of the devourers that are in secret, O Jātavedas, them do thou, increasing through worship (bráhman)—slay of them, O Agni, with hundredfold transfixion.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् वसु वसवो धारयन्त्विन्द्रः पूषा वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।
इममादित्या उत विश्वे च देवा उत्तरस्मिन् ज्योतिषि धारयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
asmin vasu vasavo dharayantvindrah pusha varuno mitro agnih |
imamaditya uta vishve cha deva uttarasmin jyotishi dharayantu ||

verses.sa:
अस्य देवाः प्रदिशि ज्योतिरस्तु सूर्यो अग्निरुत वा हिरण्यम् ।
सपत्ना अस्मदधरे भवन्तूत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम् ॥
verses.rom:
asya devah pradishi jyotirastu suryo agniruta va hiranyam |
sapatna asmadadhare bhavantuttamam nakamadhi rohayemam ||

verses.sa:
येनेन्द्राय समभरः पयांस्युत्तमेन ब्रह्मणा जातवेदः ।
तेन त्वमग्न इह वर्धयेमं सजातानां श्रैष्ठ्य आ धेह्येनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yenendraya samabharah payamsyuttamena brahmana jatavedah |
tena tvamagna iha vardhayemam sajatanam shraishthya a dhehyenam ||

verses.sa:
ऐषां यज्ञमुत वर्चो ददेऽहं रायस्पोषमुत चित्तान्यग्ने ।
सपत्ना अस्मदधरे भवन्तूत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम् ॥
verses.rom:
aisham yajnamuta varcho dade'ham rayasposhamuta chittanyagne |
sapatna asmadadhare bhavantuttamam nakamadhi rohayemam ||

prose.en:
1. In this man let the Vasus maintain good things (vásu)—Indra, Pūshan, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni; him let the Ādityas and also the All-gods maintain in superior light.

3. With what highest worship (bráhman), O Jātavedas, thou didst bring together draughts (páyas) for Indra, therewith, O Agni, do thou increase this man here; set him in supremacy (çrāíṣṭhya) over his fellows (sajātá).

4. I take to myself their sacrifice and splendor (várcas), their abundance of wealth and their intents (cittá), O Agni; be his rivals inferior to him; to the highest firmament make this man ascend.

verses.sa:
अयं देवानामसुरो वि राजति वशा हि सत्या वरुणस्य राज्ञः ।
ततस्परि ब्रह्मणा शाशदान उग्रस्य मन्योरुदिमं नयामि ॥
verses.rom:
ayam devanamasuro vi rajati vasha hi satya varunasya rajnah |
tataspari brahmana shashadana ugrasya manyorudimam nayami ||
verses.en: This Asura bears rule over the gods; for the wills (váça) of king Varuṇa [come] true; from him, prevailing by my worship (bráhman), from the fury of the formidable one (ugrá) do I lead up this man.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते रजन् वरुणास्तु मन्यवे विश्वं ह्युग्र निचिकेषि द्रुग्धम् ।
सहस्रमन्यान् प्र सुवामि साकं शतं जीवाति शरदस्तवायम् ॥
verses.rom:
namaste rajan varunastu manyave vishvam hyugra nichikeshi drugdham |
sahasramanyan pra suvami sakam shatam jivati sharadastavayam ||
verses.en: Homage be to thy fury, O king Varuṇa; for, O formidable one, thou dost note (ni-ci) every malice (drugdhá). A thousand others I impel (pra-sū) together; a hundred autumns of thee shall this man live.

verses.sa:
यदुवक्थानृतं जिह्वया वृजिनं बहु ।
राज्ञस्त्वा सत्यधर्मणो मुञ्चामि वरुणादहम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaduvakthanritam jihvaya vrijinam bahu |
rajnastva satyadharmano munchami varunadaham ||
verses.en: In that thou hast spoken with the tongue untruth, much wrong—from the king of true ordinances (-dhárman), from Varuṇa, I release thee.

verses.sa:
मुञ्चामि त्वा वैश्वानरादर्णवान् महतस्परि ।
सजातान् उग्रेहा वद ब्रह्म चाप चिकीहि नः ॥
verses.rom:
munchami tva vaishvanaradarnavan mahataspari |
sajatan ugreha vada brahma chapa chikihi nah ||
verses.en: I release thee out of the universal, the great flood (arṇavá); speak, O formidable one, unto [thy] fellows here, and reverence our incantation (bráhman).

verses.sa:
वषट्ते पूषन्न् अस्मिन्त्सूतावर्यमा होता कृणोतु वेधाः ।
सिस्रतां नार्यृतप्रजाता वि पर्वाणि जिहतां सूतवा उ ॥
verses.rom:
vashatte pushann asmintsutavaryama hota krinotu vedhah |
sisratam naryritaprajata vi parvani jihatam sutava u ||
verses.en: At this birth, O Pūshan, let Aryaman [as] efficient (vedhás) invoker utter váṣaṭ for thee; let the woman, rightly engendered, be relaxed; let her joints go apart in order to birth.

verses.sa:
चतस्रो दिवः प्रदिशश्चतस्रो भूम्या उत ।
देवा गर्भं समैरयन् तं व्यूर्णुवन्तु सूतवे ॥
verses.rom:
chatasro divah pradishashchatasro bhumya uta |
deva garbham samairayan tam vyurnuvantu sutave ||
verses.en: Four [are] the directions of the sky, four also of the earth: the gods sent together the fœtus; let them unclose her in order to birth.

verses.sa:
सूषा व्यूर्णोतु वि योनिं हापयामसि ।
श्रथया सूषणे त्वमव त्वं बिष्कले सृज ॥
verses.rom:
susha vyurnotu vi yonim hapayamasi |
shrathaya sushane tvamava tvam bishkale srija ||
verses.en: Let Pūshan (?) unclose [her or it]; we make the yóni go apart; do thou, sūṣaṇā, loosen; do thou, biṣkalā, let go.

verses.sa:
नेव मांसे न पीवसि नेव मज्जस्वाहतम् ।
अवैतु पृश्नि शेवलं शुने जराय्वत्तवेऽव जरायु पद्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
neva mamse na pivasi neva majjasvahatam |
avaitu prishni shevalam shune jarayvattave'va jarayu padyatam ||
verses.en: Not as it were stuck (ā́hata) in the flesh, not in the fat, not as it were in the marrows, let the spotted slimy (?) afterbirth come down, for the dog to eat; let the afterbirth descend.

verses.sa:
वि ते भिनद्मि मेहनं वि योनिं वि गवीनिके ।
वि मातरं च पुत्रं च वि कुमारं जरायुणाव जरायु पद्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi te bhinadmi mehanam vi yonim vi gavinike |
vi mataram cha putram cha vi kumaram jarayunava jarayu padyatam ||
verses.en: I split apart thy urinator, apart the yóni, apart the [two] groins, apart both the mother and the child, apart the boy from the afterbirth; let the afterbirth descend.

verses.sa:
यथा वातो यथा मनो यथा पतन्ति पक्षिणः ।
एवा त्वं दशमास्य साकं जरायुणा पताव जरायु पद्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vato yatha mano yatha patanti pakshinah |
eva tvam dashamasya sakam jarayuna patava jarayu padyatam ||
verses.en: As the wind, as the mind, as fly the birds, so do thou, O ten months' [child], fly along with the afterbirth; let the afterbirth descend.

verses.sa:
जरायुजः प्रथम उस्रियो वृषा वाताभ्रजा स्तनयन्न् एति वृष्ट्या ।
स नो मृडाति तन्व ऋजुगो रुजन् य एकमोजस्त्रेधा विचक्रमे ॥
verses.rom:
jarayujah prathama usriyo vrisha vatabhraja stanayann eti vrishtya |
sa no mridati tanva rijugo rujan ya ekamojastredha vichakrame ||
verses.en: First born of the afterbirth, the ruddy (usríya) bull, born of wind and cloud (?), goes thundering with rain; may he be merciful to our body, going straight on, breaking; he who, one force, hath stridden out threefold.

verses.sa:
अङ्गेअङ्गे शोचिषा शिश्रियाणं नमस्यन्तस्त्वा हविषा विधेम ।
अङ्कान्त्समङ्कान् हविषा विधेम यो अग्रभीत्पर्वास्या ग्रभीता ॥
verses.rom:
angeange shochisha shishriyanam namasyantastva havisha vidhema |
ankantsamankan havisha vidhema yo agrabhitparvasya grabhita ||
verses.en: Thee, lurking (çri) in each limb with burning (çocís), we, paying homage, would worship (vidh) with oblation; we would worship with oblation the hooks, the grapples, [him] who, a seizer, hath seized this man's joints.

verses.sa:
मुञ्च शीर्षक्त्या उत कास एनं परुष्परुराविवेशा यो अस्य ।
यो अभ्रजा वातजा यश्च शुष्मो वनस्पतीन्त्सचतां पर्वतांश्च ॥
verses.rom:
muncha shirshaktya uta kasa enam parushparuravivesha yo asya |
yo abhraja vataja yashcha shushmo vanaspatintsachatam parvatamshcha ||
verses.en: Release thou him from headache and from cough—whoever hath entered each joint of him; the blast (? çúṣma) that is cloud-born and that is wind-born, let it attach itself to forest-trees (vánaspáti) and mountains.

verses.sa:
शं मे परस्मै गात्राय शमस्त्ववराय मे ।
शं मे चतुर्भ्यो अङ्गेभ्यः शमस्तु तन्वे मम ॥
verses.rom:
sham me parasmai gatraya shamastvavaraya me |
sham me chaturbhyo angebhyah shamastu tanve mama ||
verses.en: Weal [be] to my upper member (gā́tra), weal be to my lower, weal to my four limbs; weal be to my body.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अस्तु विद्युते नमस्ते स्तनयित्नवे ।
नमस्ते अस्त्वश्मने येना दूडाशे अस्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
namaste astu vidyute namaste stanayitnave |
namaste astvashmane yena dudashe asyasi ||
verses.en: Homage be to thy lightning, homage to thy thunder; homage be to thy bolt (áçman), with which thou hurlest at the impious one (dūḍáç).

verses.sa:
नमस्ते प्रवतो नपाद्यतस्तपः समूहसि ।
मृडया नस्तनूभ्यो मयस्तोकेभ्यस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
namaste pravato napadyatastapah samuhasi |
mridaya nastanubhyo mayastokebhyaskridhi ||
verses.en: Homage to thee, child of the height (pravát), whence thou gatherest (sam-ūh) heat (tápas); be merciful to ourselves; do kindness (máyas) to our offspring (toká).

verses.sa:
प्रवतो नपान् नम एवास्तु तुभ्यं नमस्ते हेतये तपुषे च कृण्मः ।
विद्म ते धाम परमं गुहा यत्समुद्रे अन्तर्निहितासि नाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
pravato napan nama evastu tubhyam namaste hetaye tapushe cha krinmah |
vidma te dhama paramam guha yatsamudre antarnihitasi nabhih ||
verses.en: Child of the height, be homage to thee; homage we pay to thy missile (hetí) and heat (tápus); we know thy highest abode (dhā́man) that is in secret; thou art set as navel within the [cloud-]ocean.

verses.sa:
यां त्वा देवा असृजन्त विश्व इषुं कृण्वाना असनाय धृष्णुम् ।
सा नो मृड विदथे गृणाना तस्यै ते नमो अस्तु देवि ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva deva asrijanta vishva ishum krinvana asanaya dhrishnum |
sa no mrida vidathe grinana tasyai te namo astu devi ||
verses.en: Thou whom all the gods did create, the bold one, [the gods] making an arrow for hurling—do thou, besung in the council (vidátha), be merciful to us; to thee as such be homage, O goddess.

verses.sa:
भगमस्या वर्च आदिष्यधि वृक्षादिव स्रजम् ।
महाबुध्न इव पर्वतो ज्योक्पितृष्वास्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhagamasya varcha adishyadhi vrikshadiva srajam |
mahabudhna iva parvato jyokpitrishvastam ||
verses.en: Her portion (bhága), splendor have I taken to myself, as from off a tree a garland; like a mountain with great base, let her sit long with the Fathers.

verses.sa:
एषा ते राजन् कन्या वधूर्नि धूयतां यम ।
सा मातुर्बध्यतां गृहेऽथो भ्रातुरथो पितुः ॥
verses.rom:
esha te rajan kanya vadhurni dhuyatam yama |
sa maturbadhyatam grihe'tho bhraturatho pituh ||
verses.en: Let this girl, O king, be shaken down to thee [as] bride, O Yama; be she bound in her mother's house, also in her brother's, also in her father's.

verses.sa:
एषा ते कुलपा राजन् तामु ते परि दद्मसि ।
ज्योक्पितृष्वासाता आ शीर्ष्णः शमोप्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
esha te kulapa rajan tamu te pari dadmasi |
jyokpitrishvasata a shirshnah shamopyat ||
verses.en: She is thy housekeeper, O king; we commit her to thee; she shall sit long with the Fathers, until the covering in of her head.

verses.sa:
असितस्य ते ब्रह्मणा कश्यपस्य गयस्य च ।
अन्तःकोशमिव जामयोऽपि नह्यामि ते भगम् ॥
verses.rom:
asitasya te brahmana kashyapasya gayasya cha |
antahkoshamiva jamayo'pi nahyami te bhagam ||
verses.en: With the incantation (bráman) of Asita, of Kaçyapa, and of Gaya, I shut up (api-nah) thy portion (vulva?), as sisters do what is within a box (-kóça).

verses.sa:
सं सं स्रवन्तु सिन्धवः सं वाताः सं पतत्रिणः ।
इमं यज्ञं प्रदिवो मे जुषन्तां संस्राव्येण हविषा जुहोमि ॥
verses.rom:
sam sam sravantu sindhavah sam vatah sam patatrinah |
imam yajnam pradivo me jushantam samsravyena havisha juhomi ||
verses.en: Together, together let the rivers flow, together the winds, together the birds (patatrín); this my sacrifice let them enjoy of old; I offer with a confluent (saṁsrāvyà) oblation.

verses.sa:
इहैव हवमा यात म इह संस्रावणा उतेमं वर्धयता गिरः ।
इहैतु सर्वो यः पशुरस्मिन् तिष्ठतु या रयिः ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva havama yata ma iha samsravana utemam vardhayata girah |
ihaitu sarvo yah pashurasmin tishthatu ya rayih ||
verses.en: Come straight hither to my call, hither ye confluents also; increase this man, ye songs; let every beast (paçú) there is come hither; let what wealth (rayí) there is stay (sthā) with him.

verses.sa:
ये नदीनां संस्रवन्त्युत्सासः सदमक्षिताः ।
तेभिर्मे सर्वैः संस्रावैर्धनं सं स्रावयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ye nadinam samsravantyutsasah sadamakshitah |
tebhirme sarvaih samsravairdhanam sam sravayamasi ||
verses.en: What fountains of the streams flow together, ever unexhausted, with all those confluences we make riches (dhána) flow together for me.

verses.sa:
ये सर्पिषः संस्रवन्ति क्षीरस्य चोदकस्य च
तेभिर्मे सर्वैः संस्रावैर्धनं सं स्रावयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ye sarpishah samsravanti kshirasya chodakasya cha
tebhirme sarvaih samsravairdhanam sam sravayamasi ||
verses.en: What [fountains] of butter (sarpís) flow together, and of milk, and of water, with all those confluences we make riches flow together for me.

verses.sa:
येऽमावास्यां रात्रिमुदस्थुर्व्राजमत्त्रिणः ।
अग्निस्तुरीयो यातुहा सो अस्मभ्यमधि ब्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
ye'mavasyam ratrimudasthurvrajamattrinah |
agnisturiyo yatuha so asmabhyamadhi bravat ||
verses.en: What devourers, on the night of new moon, have arisen troop-wise (?)—the fourth Agni is the demon-slayer; he shall bless us.

verses.sa:
सीसायाध्याह वरुणः सीसायाग्निरुपावति ।
सीसं म इन्द्रः प्रायच्छत्तदङ्ग यातुचातनम् ॥
verses.rom:
sisayadhyaha varunah sisayagnirupavati |
sisam ma indrah prayachchhattadanga yatuchatanam ||
verses.en: The lead Varuṇa blesses; the lead Agni favors; Indra bestowed on me the lead; it, surely, is a dispeller of familiar demons.

verses.sa:
इदं विष्कन्धं सहत इदं बाधते अत्त्रिणः ।
अनेन विश्वा ससहे या जातानि पिशाच्याः ॥
verses.rom:
idam vishkandham sahata idam badhate attrinah |
anena vishva sasahe ya jatani pishachyah ||
verses.en: This overpowers the víṣkandha; this drives off (bādh) the devourers; with this I overpower all the races (jātá) that are the piçācī́'s.

verses.sa:
यदि नो गां हंसि यद्यश्वं यदि पूरुषम् ।
तं त्वा सीसेन विध्यामो यथा नोऽसो अवीरहा ॥
verses.rom:
yadi no gam hamsi yadyashvam yadi purusham |
tam tva sisena vidhyamo yatha no'so aviraha ||
verses.en: If our cow thou slayest, if [our] horse, if [our] man (púruṣa), we pierce thee there with lead, that thou be no slayer of our heroes.

verses.sa:
अमूर्या यन्ति योषितो हिरा लोहितवाससः ।
अभ्रातर इव जामयस्तिष्ठन्तु हतवर्चसः ॥
verses.rom:
amurya yanti yoshito hira lohitavasasah |
abhratara iva jamayastishthantu hatavarchasah ||
verses.en: Yon women (yoṣít) that go, veins with red garments, like brotherless sisters (jāmí)—let them stop (sthā), with their splendor smitten.

verses.sa:
तिष्ठावरे तिष्ठ पर उत त्वं तिष्ठ मध्यमे ।
कनिष्ठिका च तिष्ठति तिष्ठादिद्धमनिर्मही ॥
verses.rom:
tishthavare tishtha para uta tvam tishtha madhyame |
kanishthika cha tishthati tishthadiddhamanirmahi ||
verses.en: Stop, lower one! stop, upper one! do thou too stop, midmost one! if the smallest stops, shall stop forsooth the great tube (dhamáni).

verses.sa:
शतस्य धमनीनां सहस्रस्य हिराणाम् ।
अस्थुरिन् मध्यमा इमाः साकमन्ता अरंसत ॥
verses.rom:
shatasya dhamaninam sahasrasya hiranam |
asthurin madhyama imah sakamanta aramsata ||
verses.en: Of the hundred tubes, of the thousand veins, have stopped forsooth these midmost ones; the ends have rested (ram) together.

verses.sa:
परि वः सिकतावती धनूर्बृहत्यक्रमीत्।
तिष्ठतेलयता सु कम् ॥
verses.rom:
pari vah sikatavati dhanurbrihatyakramit|
tishthatelayata su kam ||
verses.en: About you hath gone (kram) a great gravelly sandbank (dhanū́); stop [and] be quiet, I pray (sú kam).

verses.sa:
निर्लक्ष्म्यं ललाम्यं निररातिं सुवामसि ।
अथ या भद्रा तानि नः प्रजाया अरातिं नयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
nirlakshmyam lalamyam niraratim suvamasi |
atha ya bhadra tani nah prajaya aratim nayamasi ||
verses.en: Out we drive (nir-sū) the pallid sign, out the niggard; then, whatever things are excellent (bhadrá), those we lead together (?) for our progeny.

verses.sa:
निररणिं सविता साविषक्पदोर्निर्हस्तयोर्वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
निरस्मभ्यमनुमती रराणा प्रेमां देवा असाविषुः सौभगाय ॥
verses.rom:
niraranim savita savishakpadornirhastayorvaruno mitro aryama |
nirasmabhyamanumati rarana premam deva asavishuh saubhagaya ||
verses.en: Savitar has driven out the trouble (? draṇi) in her feet; out have Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman [driven] [that] in her hands; out hath Anumati, bestowing (rā) upon us; the gods have driven this woman forward unto good fortune.

verses.sa:
यत्त आत्मनि तन्वां घोरमस्ति यद्वा केशेषु प्रतिचक्षणे वा ।
सर्वं तद्वाचाप हन्मो वयं देवस्त्वा सविता सूदयतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatta atmani tanvam ghoramasti yadva kesheshu pratichakshane va |
sarvam tadvachapa hanmo vayam devastva savita sudayatu ||
verses.en: Whatever in thy self, in thy body, is frightful, or what in hair or in mien—all that do we smite away with [our] words; let god Savitar advance (sūd) thee.

verses.sa:
रिश्यपदीं वृषदतीं गोषेधां विधमामुत ।
विलीढ्यं ललाम्यं ता अस्मन् नाशयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
rishyapadim vrishadatim goshedham vidhamamuta |
vilidhyam lalamyam ta asman nashayamasi ||
verses.en: The antelope-footed, the bull-toothed, the kine-repelling, the out-blowing, the licked-out, the pallid—these we make disappear from us.

verses.sa:
मा नो विदन् विव्याधिनो मो अभिव्याधिनो विदन् ।
आराच्छरव्या अस्मद्विषूचीरिन्द्र पातय ॥
verses.rom:
ma no vidan vivyadhino mo abhivyadhino vidan |
arachchharavya asmadvishuchirindra pataya ||
verses.en: Let not the piercers find us, nor let the penetraters find [us]; far from us make the volleys (çaravyā̀) fly, dispersing, O Indra.

verses.sa:
विष्वञ्चो अस्मच्छरवः पतन्तु ये अस्ता ये चास्याः ।
दैवीर्मनुष्येषवो ममामित्रान् वि विध्यत ॥
verses.rom:
vishvancho asmachchharavah patantu ye asta ye chasyah |
daivirmanushyeshavo mamamitran vi vidhyata ||
verses.en: Dispersing from us let the shafts fly, those that are hurled and that are to be hurled; ye divine arrows of men (manuṣyà-), pierce my enemies.

verses.sa:
यो नः स्वो यो अरणः सजात उत निष्ट्यो यो अस्मामभिदासति ।
रुद्रः शरव्ययैतान् ममामित्रान् वि विध्यतु ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah svo yo aranah sajata uta nishtyo yo asmamabhidasati |
rudrah sharavyayaitan mamamitran vi vidhyatu ||
verses.en: Whether one of our own or whether a stranger, fellow or outsider, whoso assails (abhi-dās) us—let Rudra with a volley pierce those my enemies.

verses.sa:
यः सपत्नो योऽसपत्नो यश्च द्विषन् छपाति नः ।
देवास्तं सर्वे धूर्वन्तु ब्रह्म वर्म ममान्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
yah sapatno yo'sapatno yashcha dvishan chhapati nah |
devastam sarve dhurvantu brahma varma mamantaram ||
verses.en: Whatever rival (sapátna), whatever non-rival, and whatever hater shall curse us, him let all the gods damage (dhūrv); incantation (bráhman) is my inner defense.

verses.sa:
अदारसृद्भवतु देव सोमास्मिन् यज्ञे मरुतो मृडता नः ।
मा नो विददभिभा मो अशस्तिर्मा नो विदद्वृजिना द्वेष्या या ॥
verses.rom:
adarasridbhavatu deva somasmin yajne maruto mridata nah |
ma no vidadabhibha mo ashastirma no vidadvrijina dveshya ya ||
verses.en: Let there be the ádārasṛt, O god Soma; at this sacrifice, O Maruts, be gracious to us; let not a portent find us, nor an imprecation; let not the wrong that is hateful find us.

verses.sa:
यो अद्य सेन्यो वधोऽघायूनामुदीरते ।
युवं तं मित्रावरुणावस्मद्यावयतं परि ॥
verses.rom:
yo adya senyo vadho'ghayunamudirate |
yuvam tam mitravarunavasmadyavayatam pari ||
verses.en: What missile (sénya) weapon of the malignant (aghāyú) shall go up today, do ye, Mitra-and-Varuṇa, keep that off from us.

verses.sa:
इतश्च यदमुतश्च यद्वधं वरुण यावय ।
वि महच्छर्म यच्छ वरीयो यावया वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
itashcha yadamutashcha yadvadham varuna yavaya |
vi mahachchharma yachchha variyo yavaya vadham ||
verses.en: Both what [is] from here and what from yonder—keep off, O Varuṇa, the deadly weapon; extend great protection (çárman); keep very far off the deadly weapon.

verses.sa:
शास इत्था महामस्यमित्रसाहो अस्तृतः ।
न यस्य हन्यते सखा न जीयते कदा चन ॥
verses.rom:
shasa ittha mahamasyamitrasaho astritah |
na yasya hanyate sakha na jiyate kada chana ||
verses.en: Verily a great ruler (çāsá) art thou, overpowerer of enemies, unsubdued, whose companion (sákhi) is not slain, is not scathed (jyā) at any time.

verses.sa:
स्वस्तिदा विशां पतिर्वृत्रहा विमृधो वशी ।
वृषेन्द्रः पुर एतु नः सोमपा अभयंकरः ॥
verses.rom:
svastida visham patirvritraha vimridho vashi |
vrishendrah pura etu nah somapa abhayamkarah ||
verses.en: Giver of well-being, lord of the people (víç), Vṛtra-slayer, remover of scorners, controlling, let the bull Indra go before us, soma-drinker, producing fearlessness.

verses.sa:
वि न इन्द्र मृधो जहि नीचा यच्छ पृतन्यतः ।
अधमं गमया तमो यो अस्मामभिदासति ॥
verses.rom:
vi na indra mridho jahi nicha yachchha pritanyatah |
adhamam gamaya tamo yo asmamabhidasati ||
verses.en: Smite away, O Indra, our scorners (mṛ́dh); put (yam) down them that fight (pṛtany) [us]; make go to lowest darkness whoso vexes us.

verses.sa:
वि रक्षो वि मृधो जहि वि वृत्रस्य हनू रुज ।
वि मन्युमिन्द्र वृत्रहन्न् अमित्रस्याभिदासतः ॥
verses.rom:
vi raksho vi mridho jahi vi vritrasya hanu ruja |
vi manyumindra vritrahann amitrasyabhidasatah ||
verses.en: Smite away the demon, away the scorners; break apart Vṛtra's (two) jaws; away, O Indra, Vṛtra-slayer, the fury of the vexing enemy.

verses.sa:
अपेन्द्र द्विषतो मनोऽप जिज्यासतो वधम् ।
वि महच्छर्म यच्छ वरीयो यावया वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
apendra dvishato mano'pa jijyasato vadham |
vi mahachchharma yachchha variyo yavaya vadham ||
verses.en: Off, O Indra, the mind of the hater, off the deadly weapon of him that would scathe; extend great protection; keep very far off the deadly weapon.

verses.sa:
अनु सूर्यमुदयतां हृद्द्योतो हरिमा च ते ।
गो रोहितस्य वर्णेन तेन त्वा परि दध्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
anu suryamudayatam hriddyoto harima cha te |
go rohitasya varnena tena tva pari dadhmasi ||
verses.en: Let them (both) go up toward the sun, thy heart-burn (-dyota) and yellowness; with the color of the red bull, with that we enclose (pari-dhā) thee.

verses.sa:
परि त्वा रोहितैर्वर्णैर्दीर्घायुत्वाय दध्मसि ।
यथायमरपा असदथो अहरितो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
pari tva rohitairvarnairdirghayutvaya dadhmasi |
yathayamarapa asadatho aharito bhuvat ||
verses.en: With red colors we enclose thee, in order to length of life; that this man may be free from complaints (-rápas), also may become not yellow.

verses.sa:
या रोहिणीर्देवत्या गावो या उत रोहिणीः ।
रूपंरूपं वयोवयस्ताभिष्ट्वा परि दध्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
ya rohinirdevatya gavo ya uta rohinih |
rupamrupam vayovayastabhishtva pari dadhmasi ||
verses.en: They that have the red one for divinity, and the kine that are red—form after form, vigor (váyas) after vigor, with them we enclose thee.

verses.sa:
शुकेषु ते हरिमाणं रोपणाकासु दध्मसि ।
अथो हारिद्रवेषु ते हरिमाणं नि दध्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
shukeshu te harimanam ropanakasu dadhmasi |
atho haridraveshu te harimanam ni dadhmasi ||
verses.en: In the parrots, in the ropaṇā́kās, we put thy yellowness; likewise in the hā́ridravas we deposit thy yellowness.

verses.sa:
नक्तंजातासि ओषधे रामे कृष्णे असिक्नि च ।
इदं रजनि रजय किलासं पलितं च यत् ॥
verses.rom:
naktamjatasi oshadhe rame krishne asikni cha |
idam rajani rajaya kilasam palitam cha yat ||
verses.en: Night-born art thou, O herb, O dark, black, [and] dusky one; O colorer (rajanī), do thou color this leprous spot and what is pale (palitá).

verses.sa:
किलासं च पलितं च निरितो नाशया पृषत्।
आ त्वा स्वो विशतां वर्णः परा शुक्लानि पातय ॥
verses.rom:
kilasam cha palitam cha nirito nashaya prishat|
a tva svo vishatam varnah para shuklani pataya ||
verses.en: The leprous spot, what is pale, do thou cause to disappear from hence, the speckled; let thine own color enter thee; make white things (çuklá) fly away.

verses.sa:
असितं ते प्रलयनमास्थानमसितं तव ।
असिक्नी अस्योषधे निरितो नाशया पृषत् ॥
verses.rom:
asitam te pralayanamasthanamasitam tava |
asikni asyoshadhe nirito nashaya prishat ||
verses.en: Dusky is thy hiding-place, dusky thy station (āsthā́na); dusky art thou, O herb; make the speckled disappear from hence.

verses.sa:
अस्थिजस्य किलासस्य तनूजस्य च यत्त्वचि ।
दूष्या कृतस्य ब्रह्मणा लक्ष्म श्वेतमनीनशम् ॥
verses.rom:
asthijasya kilasasya tanujasya cha yattvachi |
dushya kritasya brahmana lakshma shvetamaninasham ||
verses.en: Of the bone-born leprous spot, and of the body-born that is in the skin, of that made by the spoiler (dū́ṣi)—by incantation have I made the white (çvetá) mark disappear.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णो जातः प्रथमस्तस्य त्वं पित्तमासिथ ।
तदासुरी युधा जिता रूपं चक्रे वनस्पतीन् ॥
verses.rom:
suparno jatah prathamastasya tvam pittamasitha |
tadasuri yudha jita rupam chakre vanaspatin ||
verses.en: The eagle (suparṇá) was born first; of it thou wast the gall; then the Asura-woman, conquered by fight (yúdh), took shape as forest-trees.

verses.sa:
आसुरी चक्रे प्रथमेदं किलासभेषजमिदं किलासनाशनम् ।
अनीनशत्किलासं सरूपामकरत्त्वचम् ॥
verses.rom:
asuri chakre prathamedam kilasabheshajamidam kilasanashanam |
aninashatkilasam sarupamakarattvacham ||
verses.en: The Asura-woman first made this remedy for leprous spot, this

verses.sa:
सरूपा नाम ते माता सरूपो नाम ते पिता ।
सरूपकृत्त्वमोषधे सा सरूपमिदं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sarupa nama te mata sarupo nama te pita |
sarupakrittvamoshadhe sa sarupamidam kridhi ||
verses.en: Uniform by name is thy mother; uniform by name is thy father; uniform-making art thou, O herb; so do thou make this uniform.

verses.sa:
श्यामा सरूपंकरणी पृथिव्या अध्युद्भृता ।
इदमू षु प्र साधय पुना रूपाणि कल्पय ॥
verses.rom:
shyama sarupamkarani prithivya adhyudbhrita |
idamu shu pra sadhaya puna rupani kalpaya ||
verses.en: The swarthy, uniform-making one [is] brought up off the earth; do thou accomplish this, we pray; make the forms right again.

verses.sa:
यदग्निरापो अदहत्प्रविश्य यत्राकृण्वन् धर्मधृतो नमांसि ।
तत्र त आहुः परमं जनित्रं स नः संविद्वान् परि वृङ्ग्धि तक्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
yadagnirapo adahatpravishya yatrakrinvan dharmadhrito namamsi |
tatra ta ahuh paramam janitram sa nah samvidvan pari vringdhi takman ||
verses.en: As Agni, entering, burned the waters, where the maintainers of duty (dhárma-) paid acts of homage, there they declare to be thy highest birth-place; then do thou, O fever (takmán), complaisant, avoid us.

verses.sa:
यद्यर्चिर्यदि वासि शोचिः शकल्येषि यदि वा ते जनित्रम् ।
ह्रूडुर्नामासि हरितस्य देव स नः संविद्वान् परि वृङ्ग्धि तक्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
yadyarchiryadi vasi shochih shakalyeshi yadi va te janitram |
hrudurnamasi haritasya deva sa nah samvidvan pari vringdhi takman ||
verses.en: If thou art flame (arcís) or if heat (çocís), or if thy birth-place seeks the shavings (?), hrū́ḍu by name art thou, O god of the yellow one; then do thou, O fever, complaisant, avoid us.

verses.sa:
यदि शोको यदि वाभिशोको यदि वा राज्ञो वरुणस्यासि पुत्रः ।
ह्रूडुर्नामासि हरितस्य देव स नः संविद्वान् परि वृङ्ग्धि तक्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
yadi shoko yadi vabhishoko yadi va rajno varunasyasi putrah |
hrudurnamasi haritasya deva sa nah samvidvan pari vringdhi takman ||
verses.en: If heating (çoká) or if scorching (abhiçoká), or if thou art son of king Varuṇa, hrúḍu by name etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नमः शीताय तक्मने नमो रूराय शोचिषे कृणोमि ।
यो अन्येद्युरुभयद्युरभ्येति तृतीयकाय नमो अस्तु तक्मने ॥
verses.rom:
namah shitaya takmane namo ruraya shochishe krinomi |
yo anyedyurubhayadyurabhyeti tritiyakaya namo astu takmane ||
verses.en: Homage to the cold fever, homage I pay to the fierce (rūrá) heat (çocís); to the one that befalls on every other day, on both days, to the third-day fever be homage.

verses.sa:
आरेऽसावस्मदस्तु हेतिर्देवासो असत्।
आरे अश्मा यमस्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
are'savasmadastu hetirdevaso asat|
are ashma yamasyatha ||
verses.en: Far be that from us—may [your] missile (hetí) be, O gods; far the bolt (áçman) which ye hurl.

verses.sa:
सखासावस्मभ्यमस्तु रातिः सखेन्द्रो भगः ।
सविता चित्रराधाः ॥
verses.rom:
sakhasavasmabhyamastu ratih sakhendro bhagah |
savita chitraradhah ||
verses.en: Be yon Rāti ('liberality') a companion (sákhi) for us; a companion [be] Indra, Bhaga, Savitar of wondrous favors.

verses.sa:
यूयं नः प्रवतो नपान् मरुतः सूर्यत्वचसः ।
शर्म यच्छथ सप्रथाः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam nah pravato napan marutah suryatvachasah |
sharma yachchhatha saprathah ||
verses.en: May ye, issue (nápāt) of the height, sun-skinned Maruts, yield us breadthful protection.

verses.sa:
सुषूदत मृडत मृडया नस्तनूभ्यो ।
मयस्तोकेभ्यस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
sushudata mridata mridaya nastanubhyo |
mayastokebhyaskridhi ||
verses.en: Do ye advance [us], be gracious; be thou gracious to our selves (tanū́), show kindness (máyas) to our offspring (toká).

verses.sa:
अमूः पारे पृदाक्वस्त्रिषप्ता निर्जरायवः ।
तासां जरायुभिर्वयमक्ष्यावपि व्ययामस्यघायोः परिपन्थिनः ॥
verses.rom:
amuh pare pridakvastrishapta nirjarayavah |
tasam jarayubhirvayamakshyavapi vyayamasyaghayoh paripanthinah ||
verses.en: Yonder on the further shore are she-adders, thrice seven, out of their sloughs (-jarā́yu); with the sloughs of them do we wrap up (ápi vyā) the (two) eyes of the malignant waylayer.

verses.sa:
विषूच्येतु कृन्तती पिनाकमिव बिभ्रती ।
विष्वक्पुनर्भुवा मनोऽसमृद्धा अघायवः ॥
verses.rom:
vishuchyetu krintati pinakamiva bibhrati |
vishvakpunarbhuva mano'samriddha aghayavah ||
verses.en: Let the cutting one (kṛt) go asunder, she who bears as it were a club (pínăka); asunder [go] the mind of her that returns to life (punarbhú); unsuccessful [are] the malignant ones.

verses.sa:
न बहवः समशकन् नार्भका अभि दाधृषुः ।
वेणोरद्गा इवाभितोऽसमृद्धा अघायवः ॥
verses.rom:
na bahavah samashakan narbhaka abhi dadhrishuh |
venoradga ivabhito'samriddha aghayavah ||
verses.en: The many have not been able together; the few have not ventured on [it]; like the sprouts (? ádga) of a bamboo (veṇú) round about, unsuccessful [are] the malignant ones.

verses.sa:
प्रेतं पादौ प्र स्फुरतं वहतं पृणतो गृहान् ।
इन्द्रान्येतु प्रथमाजीतामुषिता पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
pretam padau pra sphuratam vahatam prinato grihan |
indranyetu prathamajitamushita purah ||
verses.en: Go forward, ye (two) feet; kick (sphur) forward; carry to the houses of the bestower (pṛ); let Indrāṇī go first, unscathed, unrobbed, in front.

verses.sa:
उप प्रागाद्देवो अग्नी रक्षोहामीवचातनः ।
दहन्न् अप द्वयाविनो यातुधानान् किमीदिनः ॥
verses.rom:
upa pragaddevo agni rakshohamivachatanah |
dahann apa dvayavino yatudhanan kimidinah ||
verses.en: Hither hath come forth god Agni, demon-slayer, disease-expeller, burning away deceivers, sorcerers, kimīdíns.

verses.sa:
प्रति दह यातुधानान् प्रति देव किमीदिनः ।
प्रतीचीः कृष्णवर्तने सं दह यातुधान्यः ॥
verses.rom:
prati daha yatudhanan prati deva kimidinah |
pratichih krishnavartane sam daha yatudhanyah ||
verses.en: Burn against the sorcerers, against the kimīdíns, O god; burn up the sorceresses that meet thee, O black-tracked one.

verses.sa:
या शशाप शपनेन याघं मूरमादधे ।
या रसस्य हरणाय जातमारेभे तोकमत्तु सा ॥
verses.rom:
ya shashapa shapanena yagham muramadadhe |
ya rasasya haranaya jatamarebhe tokamattu sa ||
verses.en: She that hath cursed with cursing, that hath taken malignity as her root (? mū́ra), that hath seized on [our] young to take its sap—let her eat [her own] offspring.

verses.sa:
पुत्रमत्तु यातुधानीः स्वसारमुत नप्त्यम् ।
अधा मिथो विकेश्यो वि घ्नतां यातुधान्यो वि तृह्यन्तामराय्यः ॥
verses.rom:
putramattu yatudhanih svasaramuta naptyam |
adha mitho vikeshyo vi ghnatam yatudhanyo vi trihyantamarayyah ||
verses.en: Let the sorceress eat [her own] son, sister, and daughter (? naptī́); then let the horrid-haired sorceresses mutually destroy (vi-han) one another; let the hags (arāyī́) be shattered asunder.

verses.sa:
अभीवर्तेन मणिना येनेन्द्रो अभिवावृधे ।
तेनास्मान् ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽभि राष्ट्राय वर्धय ॥
verses.rom:
abhivartena manina yenendro abhivavridhe |
tenasman brahmanaspate'bhi rashtraya vardhaya ||
verses.en: With an over-rolling amulet (maṇí), wherewith Indra increased—therewith, O Brahmaṇaspati, make us increase unto royalty (rāṣṭrá).

verses.sa:
अभिवृत्य सपत्नान् अभि या नो अरातयः ।
अभि पृतन्यन्तं तिष्ठाभि यो नो दुरस्यति ॥
verses.rom:
abhivritya sapatnan abhi ya no aratayah |
abhi pritanyantam tishthabhi yo no durasyati ||
verses.en: Rolling over our rivals, over them that are niggards to us, do thou trample on him who fights—on whoever abuses (durasy-) us.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा देवः सविताभि षोमो अवीवृधत्।
अभि त्वा विश्वा भूतान्यभीवर्तो यथाससि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva devah savitabhi shomo avivridhat|
abhi tva vishva bhutanyabhivarto yathasasi ||
verses.en: Thee hath god Savitar, hath Soma made to increase, thee have all existences (bhūtá) [made to increase], that thou mayest be over-rolling.

verses.sa:
अभीवर्तो अभिभवः सपत्नक्षयणो मणिः ।
राष्ट्राय मह्यं बध्यतां सपत्नेभ्यः पराभुवे ॥
verses.rom:
abhivarto abhibhavah sapatnakshayano manih |
rashtraya mahyam badhyatam sapatnebhyah parabhuve ||
verses.en: The over-rolling, overcoming, rival-destroying amulet be bound upon me unto royalty, unto the perishing (parābhū́) of rivals.

verses.sa:
उदसौ सूर्यो अगादुदिदं मामकं वचः ।
यथाहं शत्रुहोऽसान्यसपत्नः सपत्नहा ॥
verses.rom:
udasau suryo agadudidam mamakam vachah |
yathaham shatruho'sanyasapatnah sapatnaha ||
verses.en: Up hath gone yon sun, up this spell (vácas) of mine, that I may be slayer of foes, without rivals, rival-slayer.

verses.sa:
सपत्नक्षयणो वृषाभिरष्ट्रो विषासहिः ।
यथाहमेषां वीराणां विराजानि जनस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
sapatnakshayano vrishabhirashtro vishasahih |
yathahamesham viranam virajani janasya cha ||
verses.en: A rival-destroying bull, conquering royalty, overpowering—that I may bear rule over these heroes and the people (jána).

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा वसवो रक्षतेममुतादित्या जागृत यूयमस्मिन् ।
मेमं सनाभिरुत वान्यनाभिर्मेमं प्रापत्पौरुषेयो वधो यः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve deva vasavo rakshatemamutaditya jagrita yuyamasmin |
memam sanabhiruta vanyanabhirmemam prapatpaurusheyo vadho yah ||
verses.en: O all ye gods, ye Vasus, protect this man; likewise ye Ādityas, watch ye over him; him let not one related (sánābhi) nor one unrelated—him let not any deadly weapon of men (pāúruṣeya) reach.

verses.sa:
ये वो देवाः पितरो ये च पुत्राः सचेतसो मे शृणुतेदमुक्तम् ।
सर्वेभ्यो वः परि ददाम्येतं स्वस्त्येनं जरसे वहाथ ॥
verses.rom:
ye vo devah pitaro ye cha putrah sachetaso me shrinutedamuktam |
sarvebhyo vah pari dadamyetam svastyenam jarase vahatha ||
verses.en: Whoso of you, O gods, are fathers and who sons, do ye, accordant (sácetas), hear this utterance of mine; to you all I commit this man; happily unto old age shall ye carry him.

verses.sa:
ये देवा दिवि ष्ठ ये पृथिव्यां ये अन्तरिक्ष ओषधीषु पशुष्वप्स्वन्तः ।
ते कृणुत जरसमायुरस्मै शतमन्यान् परि वृणक्तु मृत्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
ye deva divi shtha ye prithivyam ye antariksha oshadhishu pashushvapsvantah |
te krinuta jarasamayurasmai shatamanyan pari vrinaktu mrityun ||
verses.en: Ye, O gods, that are in the heaven, that are on earth, that are in the atmosphere, in the herbs, in the cattle, within the waters—do ye make old age the length of life for this man; let him avoid the hundred other deaths.

verses.sa:
येषां प्रयाजा उत वानुयाजा हुतभागा अहुतादश्च देवाः ।
येषां वः पञ्च प्रदिशो विभक्तास्तान् वो अस्मै सत्रसदः कृणोमि ॥
verses.rom:
yesham prayaja uta vanuyaja hutabhaga ahutadashcha devah |
yesham vah pancha pradisho vibhaktastan vo asmai satrasadah krinomi ||
verses.en: Whose are the fore-offerings and whose the after-offerings; the gods that share the oblation and that eat what is not made oblation of; you among whom the five directions are shared out—you do I make sitters at the session (sattrá-) of this man.

verses.sa:
आशानामाशापालेभ्यश्चतुर्भ्यो अमृतेभ्यः ।
इदं भूतस्याध्यक्षेभ्यो विधेम हविषा वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashanamashapalebhyashchaturbhyo amritebhyah |
idam bhutasyadhyakshebhyo vidhema havisha vayam ||
verses.en: To the four immortal region-guardians of the regions (áçā), to the overseers of existence (bhūtá), would we now pay worship (vidh) with oblation.

verses.sa:
य आशानामाशापालाश्चत्वार स्थन देवाः ।
ते नो निर्ऋत्याः पाशेभ्यो मुञ्चतांहसोअंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ya ashanamashapalashchatvara sthana devah |
te no nirrityah pashebhyo munchatamhasoamhasah ||
verses.en: Ye, O gods, who are the four region-guardians of the regions—do ye release us from the fetters (pā́ça) of perdition (nírṛti), from every distress (áṅhas).

verses.sa:
अस्रामस्त्वा हविषा यजाम्यश्लोणस्त्वा घृतेन जुहोमि ।
य आशानामाशापालस्तुरीयो देवः स नः सुभूतमेह वक्षत् ॥
verses.rom:
asramastva havisha yajamyashlonastva ghritena juhomi |
ya ashanamashapalasturiyo devah sa nah subhutameha vakshat ||
verses.en: Unlamed I sacrifice to thee with oblation; unmaimed I make oblation to thee with ghee; the god that is fourth region-guardian of the regions, he shall bring hither to us welfare (subhūtá).

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति मात्र उत पित्रे नो अस्तु स्वस्ति गोभ्यो जगते पुरुषेभ्यः ।
विश्वं सुभूतं सुविदत्रं नो अस्तु ज्योगेव दृशेम सूर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
svasti matra uta pitre no astu svasti gobhyo jagate purushebhyah |
vishvam subhutam suvidatram no astu jyogeva drishema suryam ||
verses.en: Well-being (svastí) be to our mother and father, well-being to kine, to creatures (jágat), to men (púruṣa); all welfare [and] beneficence (? suvidátra) be ours; long may we see the sun.

verses.sa:
इदं जनासो विदथ महद्ब्रह्म वदिष्यति ।
न तत्पृथिव्यां नो दिवि येन प्राणन्ति वीरुधः ॥
verses.rom:
idam janaso vidatha mahadbrahma vadishyati |
na tatprithivyam no divi yena prananti virudhah ||
verses.en: Now, ye people, take knowledge; he will speak a great mystery (? bráhman); that is not on earth nor in the sky whereby the plants breathe.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्ष आसां स्थाम श्रान्तसदामिव ।
आस्थानमस्य भूतस्य विदुष्टद्वेधसो न वा ॥
verses.rom:
antariksha asam sthama shrantasadamiva |
asthanamasya bhutasya vidushtadvedhaso na va ||
verses.en: In the atmosphere is the station of them, as of those sitting wearied; the station of this that exists (bhūtá): that the pious know—or they do not.

verses.sa:
यद्रोदसी रेजमाने भूमिश्च निरतक्षतम् ।
आर्द्रं तदद्य सर्वदा समुद्रस्येव श्रोत्याः ॥
verses.rom:
yadrodasi rejamane bhumishcha niratakshatam |
ardram tadadya sarvada samudrasyeva shrotyah ||
verses.en: What the (two) quaking firmaments (ródasī)—and the earth—fashioned out, that at present is always wet, like the streams of the ocean.

verses.sa:
विश्वमन्यामभीवार तदन्यस्यामधि श्रितम् ।
दिवे च विश्ववेदसे पृथिव्यै चाकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvamanyamabhivara tadanyasyamadhi shritam |
dive cha vishvavedase prithivyai chakaram namah ||
verses.en: The one hath covered all; this rests upon the other; both to the heaven and to the all-possessing earth have I paid homage.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयः पावका यासु जातः सविता यास्वग्निः ।
या अग्निं गर्भं दधिरे सुवर्णास्ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyavarnah shuchayah pavaka yasu jatah savita yasvagnih |
ya agnim garbham dadhire suvarnasta na apah sham syona bhavantu ||
verses.en: Of golden color, clean (çúci), purifying, in whom [was] born Savitar, in whom Agni; who, of beauteous color, assumed Agni as embryo—let those waters be weal, pleasant to us.

verses.sa:
यासां राजा वरुणो याति मध्ये सत्यानृते अवपश्यन् जनानाम् ।
या अग्निं गर्भं दधिरे सुवर्णास्ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yasam raja varuno yati madhye satyanrite avapashyan jananam |
ya agnim garbham dadhire suvarnasta na apah sham syona bhavantu ||
verses.en: In the midst of whom goes king Varuṇa, looking down at the truth-and-falsehood of men; who, of beauteous color, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यासां देवा दिवि कृण्वन्ति भक्षं या अन्तरिक्षे बहुधा भवन्ति ।
या अग्निं गर्भं दधिरे सुवर्णास्ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yasam deva divi krinvanti bhaksham ya antarikshe bahudha bhavanti |
ya agnim garbham dadhire suvarnasta na apah sham syona bhavantu ||
verses.en: They of whom the gods in heaven make [their] draught (bhakṣá); they that come to be abundantly in the atmosphere; who, of beauteous color, etc. etc.

verses.sa:
शिवेन मा चक्षुषा पश्यतापः शिवया तन्वोप स्पृशत त्वचं मे ।
घृतश्चुतः शुचयो याः पावकास्ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
shivena ma chakshusha pashyatapah shivaya tanvopa sprishata tvacham me |
ghritashchutah shuchayo yah pavakasta na apah sham syona bhavantu ||
verses.en: With propitious eye behold me, O waters; with propitious body touch my skin; they that are ghee-dripping, clean, purifying—let those waters be weal, pleasant to us.

verses.sa:
इयं वीरुन् मधुजाता मधुना त्वा खनामसि ।
मधोरधि प्रजातासि सा नो मधुमतस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
iyam virun madhujata madhuna tva khanamasi |
madhoradhi prajatasi sa no madhumataskridhi ||
verses.en: This plant is honey-(mádhu-)born; with honey we dig thee; forth from honey art thou engendered; so do thou make us possessed of honey.

verses.sa:
जिह्वाया अग्रे मधु मे जिह्वामूले मधूलकम् ।
ममेदह क्रतावसो मम चित्तमुपायसि ॥
verses.rom:
jihvaya agre madhu me jihvamule madhulakam |
mamedaha kratavaso mama chittamupayasi ||
verses.en: At the tip of my tongue honey, at the root of my tongue honeyedness; mayest thou be altogether in my power (krátu), mayest thou come unto my intent (cittá).

verses.sa:
मधुमन् मे निक्रमणं मधुमन् मे परायणम् ।
वाचा वदामि मधुमद्भूयासं मधुसंदृशः ॥
verses.rom:
madhuman me nikramanam madhuman me parayanam |
vacha vadami madhumadbhuyasam madhusamdrishah ||
verses.en: Honeyed (mádhumant) [is] my in-stepping, honeyed my forth-going; with my voice I speak what is honeyed; may I be of honey-aspect.

verses.sa:
मधोरस्मि मधुतरो मदुघान् मधुमत्तरः ।
मामित्किल त्वं वनाः शाखां मधुमतीमिव ॥
verses.rom:
madhorasmi madhutaro madughan madhumattarah |
mamitkila tvam vanah shakham madhumatimiva ||
verses.en: Than honey am I sweeter (mádhu), than the honey-plant more honeyed; of me verily shalt thou be fond (? van), as of a honeyed branch.

verses.sa:
परि त्वा परितत्नुनेक्षुणागामविद्विषे ।
यथा मां कमिन्यसो यथा मन् नापगा असः ॥
verses.rom:
pari tva paritatnunekshunagamavidvishe |
yatha mam kaminyaso yatha man napaga asah ||
verses.en: About thee with an encompassing (paritatnú) sugar-cane have I gone, in order to absence of mutual hatred; that thou mayest be one loving me, that thou mayest be one not going away from me.

verses.sa:
यदाबध्नन् दाक्षायणा हिरण्यं शतानीकाय सुमनस्यमानाः ।
तत्ते बध्नाम्यायुषे वर्चसे बलाय दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
yadabadhnan dakshayana hiranyam shatanikaya sumanasyamanah |
tatte badhnamyayushe varchase balaya dirghayutvaya shatasharadaya ||
verses.en: What gold the descendants of Dakṣa, well-willing, bound on for Çatānīka, that I bind for thee, in order to life (ā́yus), splendor, strength, to length of life for a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
नैनं रक्षांसि न पिशाचाः सहन्ते देवानामोजः प्रथमजं ह्येतत्।
यो बिभर्ति दाक्षायणं हिरण्यं स जीवेषु कृणुते दीर्घमायुः ॥
verses.rom:
nainam rakshamsi na pishachah sahante devanamojah prathamajam hyetat|
yo bibharti dakshayanam hiranyam sa jiveshu krinute dirghamayuh ||
verses.en: Not demons, not piçācás overcome him, for this is the first-born force of the gods; whoso bears the gold of the descendants of Dakṣa, he makes for himself long life among the living.

verses.sa:
अपां तेजो ज्योतिरोजो बलं च वनस्पतीनामुत वीर्याणि ।
इन्द्र इवेन्द्रियाण्यधि धारयामो अस्मिन् तद्दक्षमाणो बिभरद्धिरण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
apam tejo jyotirojo balam cha vanaspatinamuta viryani |
indra ivendriyanyadhi dharayamo asmin taddakshamano bibharaddhiranyam ||
verses.en: The waters' brilliancy, light, force, and strength, also the heroic powers (vīryà) of the forest trees, do we maintain in him, as in Indra Indra's powers (indriyá); this gold shall he, being capable, bear.

verses.sa:
समानां मासामृतुभिष्ट्वा वयं संवत्सरस्य पयसा पिपर्मि ।
इन्द्राग्नी विश्वे देवास्तेऽनु मन्यन्तामहृणीयमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
samanam masamritubhishtva vayam samvatsarasya payasa piparmi |
indragni vishve devaste'nu manyantamahriniyamanah ||
verses.en: With seasons of summers (? sámā), of months, we [fill] thee, with the milk of the year I fill [thee]; let Indra-and-Agni, let all the gods, approve thee, not bearing enmity.
